newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore noon stocks soft, electronics shine.
newsitem.headline: Singapore noon stocks soft, electronics shine.

text.p: Singapore stocks were slightly weaker at midday on Monday after an uninspiring budget but electronic shares were lifted by a brighter outlook for the sector, dealers said.
At 0430 GMT, the Straits Times Industrials Index shed 6.27 points to 1,960.87 while the SES electronics index gained 2.85 points or 2.20 percent to 132.18.
Multimedia Creative Technology led the gainers, rising Singapore $0.60 to S$28.50 following the rally in U.S. high-technology shares late last week.
Electronic Resources, Venture Manufacturing and Datacraft were among the other electronic counters which dominated gainers.
Concerns over a weak ringgit dampened Malaysian shares. The UOB OTC index, which tracks Malaysian shares traded here, fell 5.83 points to 1,096.89.
Malaysian KLI Holdings, which has been suspended since April 30 this year, resumed trade with over 11 million shares changing hands. It lost 21 cents to S$1.61.
Foreign tranches of Singapore Press Holding fell 50 cents to S$27.90 following recent gains.
